verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog and in-app notification SaaS with an AI post-writing feature, so acting as an MCP client is a conceivable capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or consume MCP servers. The 3,000+ integrations, API and webhooks claims and the AI post writer are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
